ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: AMD is looking for a Software Engineer to develop networking firmware and software for AI infrastructure. You will be a member of a core team of industry specialists and will work with the latest GPU, NIC, switch and rack-scale technology. In this role, you will design, develop and debug embedded firmware and systems software in C/C++ for networking subsystems on AMD Helios rack-scale deployments, with a focus on Ethernet-based scale-up and scale-out networking. You will work with hardware, firmware, driver, switch software and architecture teams to deliver high-performance, reliable networking for next-generation AI infrastructure. THE PERSON: The ideal candidate is passionate about software engineering and is able to drive issues to resolution. You communicate effectively and work well with different teams across AMD. You have hands-on experience with C/C++ firmware or systems software development and a solid understanding of Ethernet networking. You are comfortable working close to the hardware, enjoy debugging problems that span firmware, drivers and the network, and are motivated to learn in a fast-moving environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: • Design, develop and maintain embedded firmware and systems software in C/C++ for networking subsystems on AMD Helios rack-scale systems • Implement firmware features for Ethernet link management, including SerDes and link initialization, MAC/PCS/FEC configuration, link status monitoring and error handling • Develop firmware interfaces and messaging between management processors, host drivers and fabric management software • Participate in new ASIC and platform bring-up, including firmware loading, link bring-up and topology validation • Work with switch software teams on L2 forwarding, VLANs, QoS and telemetry for scale-up and scale-out topologies • Develop diagnostics, logging and telemetry to monitor link and network health and speed up root cause analysis • Debug and resolve issues across firmware, drivers, NICs, switches and the network • Write unit and integration tests and support validation of networking firmware features • Analyze and improve networking performance, latency and reliability • Contribute to reliability, availability and serviceability features for large-scale clusters • Participate in design and code reviews and follow software development best practices PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: • Strong C and C++ programming skills with a keen attention to code quality • Embedded firmware development experience on microcontrollers or SoC management processors, including RTOS or bare-metal environments • Solid understanding of Ethernet networking, including L2 switching, VLANs, MAC learning, LLDP, L3 forwarding, and QoS (PFC, ETS, ECN, queue management) • Familiarity with Ethernet physical layer concepts such as MAC, PCS, FEC, SerDes and link training • Experience with Linux systems software or device drivers, including PCIe, DMA and interrupts, is a plus • Familiarity with network protocols and transports such as TCP/IP, RDMA or RoCE • Exposure to datacenter switch software such as SONiC, SAI or switch ASIC SDKs is a plus • Exposure to GPU interconnect or scale-up fabric technologies is a plus • Experience with ASIC, NIC, GPU or switch bring-up is a plus • Experience with debuggers, source code control and build systems • Scripting experience in Python or Bash for tooling and test automation • Effective communication and problem-solving skills ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent LOCATION: Santa Clara, CA This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. #LI-NP1 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
